title: Oriented inter-component pair-correlation (anisotropic second-order fault-population) prior + LiDAR strike concordance, DTI-marginal greedy placement

applied: pre-placement surface (provisional dot set = greedy placement of the live surface)
novelty_gate.registry: 992 frozen registry rasters + frozen 207-raster delta + live delta scanned this session + all GEMSDOE79 archived/artifact rasters (lane's own outputs excluded)

mechanism.strike_field: structure tensor of Gaussian(1.5 px) smoothed visible-catalogue mask, integration sigma 3 px; strike = gradient direction + 90 deg
mechanism.pair_correlation: offsets between visible pixels of DIFFERENT 8-connected components within 40 px, rotated into the source pixel's strike frame (u along, v across), folded to |u|,|v|, 2-px bins, normalised by uniform expectation; excess w=max(g-1,0); up to 30,000 source pixels, rng seed fixed
mechanism.opc_surface: sum over 12 strike bins of (visible pixels in bin) convolved with w rotated to the bin angle (81x81 kernel)
mechanism.lidar_strike_concordance: |cos 2(theta_lidar - theta_opc)| x OPC coherence; lidar strike convention fixed label-free by agreement with the structure-tensor strike of the lidar step_max band
mechanism.model: LightGBM binary, leave-one-quadrant-out; training labels from 2 simulated buffered whole-component hides (shared buffered_component_draw on the visible catalogue, seeds 9000+10*seed+draw) inside the 3 training quadrants only; negatives = allowed cells (d_simvis > 3 px) not sim-hidden, 60,000 per quadrant per draw; prior-corrected probabilities
mechanism.placement: shared vendor/gems57/emit.py::greedy_allocate(p, allowed=footprint & d_vis>3px, k_truth=sum(p[allowed])) -- exact marginal DTI bar, no holdout-tuned parameters; max_dots 120000

physics_label_free: lidar_scarp bands ex_max ex_mean step_max lapneg_max lappos_max downface_max upface_max cross_max relief coh100 valid (0=no lidar -> NaN)
log1p distance to SGMC geologic-map faults

experiments.EXP-OPC-1: geometry-only model WITH oriented OPC features vs CONTROL C-ISO geometry-only model with isotropic features only (log1p_d_vis, dens_s10, dens_s30, opc_iso); tests the anisotropy hypothesis; same placement
experiments.EXP-OPC-2: full model (geometry + OPC + physics + concordance); the candidate
experiments.EXP-OPC-3: live fit on the full catalogue with the identical recipe; pre-placement surface novelty; placement; final-dot novelty; GeoTIFF + ZIP via shared submission_writer

controls_same_folds: C0 random dots in allowed, same count as EXP-OPC-2
leakage_canary: every feature alone: symmetric AUC (truth vs allowed non-truth) on each holdout fold, both seeds; any AUC > 0.90 = leakage until proven otherwise -> stop

promotion_gates.G1_format: single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, sample transform, finite everywhere, values in [0,1], zero outside footprint
promotion_gates.G3_holdout: EXP-OPC-2 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > frozen canonical G79-THVC on BOTH seeds (0.1905 seed 20, 0.1944 seed 30) AND 2-seed mean > 0.1963 (best recorded GEMSDOE79 2-seed mean, G79-CSKD)
promotion_gates.G4_novelty: unique under D-3 on surface and final dots vs the complete accessible registry scan (no error rows treated as pass)
promotion_gates.G5_selector: scripts/opc_gate.py re-derives G1-G4 from files; sets OK TO SUBMIT only if all pass

named_non_fault_mimics: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines (linear, parallel, characteristic spacing)
